newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman's Raysut Cement 1996 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Oman's Raysut Cement 1996 profits up.

text.p: Oman's Raysut Cement Co said on Saturday its 1996 net profit climbed to 4.1 million rials ($10.8 million) from 2.9 million rials the previous year.
Sales rose to 8.1 million rials in 1996 from 7.5 million rials in 1995, the company said in a statement.
"This outstanding (financial) achievement was due to improving the efficiency of the operation, better sales and tighter control over expenses," it added.
Work on an expansion plan to lift capacity to 750,000 tonnes a year began in May. The company said increased capacity would come on stream early next year at a cost of 34.5 million rials.
The company exports 70,000-80,000 tonnes a year to Yemen, Somalia and Sri Lanka.
